captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a standard camera zoom lens with a dark alloy barrel, a ribbed zoom ring, and a separate ribbed focus ring. The lens glass is visible at the front with a semi-transparent dark appearance. The rings are designed to rotate independently about the central longitudinal axis, mimicking the mechanical adjustment of focal length and focus on a physical camera.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a camera zoom lens with a main alloy barrel, a glass front element, a ribbed focus ring, and a ribbed zoom ring. The rings should be configured with revolute joints allowing them to rotate about the central axis.
captions.factory: The model is built by defining an ArticulatedObject. The base barrel is constructed using cylindrical primitives with a central bore, adding a flat circular disk for the glass lens element. The focus and zoom rings are modeled as concentric cylinders with small rectangular blocks patterned circumferentially to create the ribbed texture. Two revolute joints are defined along the central Z-axis to connect the rotating rings to the main barrel assembly.
